# C2: Dialects

A dialect is a YAML rule file, `org-pack/dialects/<name>.yaml`. Each rule matches something in source or config files (an annotation, a base class, a method call, a config key, an XPath or JSONPath, a regular expression) and emits a catalog record (C1) from templates over what matched. Every dialect ships its own tests; a dialect whose tests fail does not load.

Specification version 0.1.0.

| Version        | Value |
| -------------- | ----- |
| Schema version | 1     |
